The old b20d recovery can be reproduced by material-only onehop with ordinary global current; diagonal-only, phase-pi, current-only and stage handoffs do not reproduce it. Grid32 and shifted-partition controls limit the explanation.
In R8 high-contrast uniform cases A+ has4/26 material successes versus A5, Global5, Dual3, single6. Sourcewise A+ has5. Different current modes confound globalAplus versus Dual.

Expected CN-noise current RMS/observedJD is4.3-6.9%,43.7-60.0%,82.6-108.2% for noise.001/.01/.03. This is a conditional expectation, not actual truth error or proof that rank17 is wrong.

R3 publishedGT hardlock state floor.0289064, noise expectation.0226618, fixed-anchor99%bound.0424996; neither a final material-error floor nor proof of dominance. clean-native and strong-release controls still fail.

Material-only NN initialization starts auxiliary current at noisyJD plus zero APCS; optional projected-current/anchor paths are separate algorithms. Lower pre-correctorPhi does not certify a better corrected material. R8case0027 is a paid counterexample.

All reviewed R8 uniform auxiliary schedules have3000steps with stoppingdisabled. Correctors often hit3000cap; numerical success also occurs with wrong materials. They are adequately paid frozen baselines, not certified convergence ceilings.

Older FBG E3 scorer genericNRMSE text8or18 conflicts with actual amplitude12, and aggregate cap/stop metadata omit rawreceipt budget stops. These are documented reporting omissions; do not attribute them to R8 numeric solver or invent a rerun.
The initial state_dof placeholder looks hardcoded but is overwritten in finally by actualmodel.n*model.ns. All630 finalreceipts agree. Not a demonstrated source-count bug.

Noise-aware soft DPCS, improved branch selection or a representation change may help, but existing evidence does not prove any one will recover highcontrast materials. No new rank/beta/stop or GT-based online choice selected here.

limitations: Targeted code/evidence review is not an exhaustive software proof. No solver/gradient rerun was authorized or performed. R8 test is now public DEVELOPMENT. Full scientific judgment remains with root.
